findings.description: Yuyang Wang: included as regular/ece/current. Card department line is blank, but group tags and the official profile name ECE.
Liang Zhang: Professor, Department Head in Faculty and Staff listings; counted once as regular/ece/current.
Brandy Ciraldo: Staff card ('Administrative Program Support 2', ECE department line) excluded as academic_professional.
Andrew Gardiner: Staff card ('Computer Support Technician I', ECE department line) excluded as academic_professional.
Celine Goorahoo: Staff card ('Administrative Program Support 3', ECE department line) excluded as academic_professional.
Jodi Peterson: Staff card ('Administrative Program Support 1', ECE department line) excluded as academic_professional.

No omissions: the 27 unique people whose department line, group tags or title name ECE on the page are exactly the 27 brief people. Andrew Gardiner's department line names ECE and his only group tag is 'Staff'. He is decided as excluded.

Page re-downloaded: 304 cards in two sections, Faculty (204) and Staff (100). The bytes differ from the prior download only in the W3 Total Cache footer timestamp (line 5386); card content is unchanged. No Emeritus, Adjunct, Lecturer or Affiliate section exists, and Emeritus tags appear only on non-ECE cards.

Profile pages were not fetched for the 25 other brief people; decisions rest on the official directory cards, which show rank and department. No incoming start dates were found, so effective_from_json is null for all records.
